description: Provide at least one company URL, domain, or name. Headcount and firmographics work without a cookie; employee rows are optional and require your own LinkedIn session cookie.

companyDomains.description: Company website domains, e.g. stripe.com or notion.so. The resolver follows LinkedIn's page website to pick the correct same-name company.
companyDomains.title: Company domains

companyNames.description: Company display names, e.g. Stripe or Microsoft. Name-only input is validated; ambiguous bare names (Notion, Linear, Cal) return an error row asking for a URL or domain.
companyNames.title: Company names

companyUrls.description: LinkedIn company page URLs. Accepts https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe/, linkedin.com/company/stripe, or company/stripe.
companyUrls.title: Company LinkedIn URLs

connectionDegree.description: Roster filter: restrict to 1st, 2nd, or 3rd+ degree connections. Cookie roster only.
connectionDegree.title: Connection degree

cookies.description: Optional LinkedIn session cookie for the employee roster. Accepts the li_at value or a full cookies JSON array. Never required for headcount/firmographics.
cookies.title: LinkedIn cookie (optional)

functions.description: Roster filter: one or more LinkedIn job functions. Empty means all functions. Cookie roster only. Allowed values: Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Human Resources, Design, Product, Customer Service, Information Technology, Legal, Other.
functions.title: Job functions

includeEmployees.description: When true, also request the employee roster. Requires a valid LinkedIn session cookie and is capped by LinkedIn at 2,500 visible results per query.
includeEmployees.title: Include employee roster

language.description: Roster filter: primary profile language. Cookie roster only.
language.title: Profile language

location.description: Roster filter: best-effort location match on the employee's LinkedIn location, e.g. London. Cookie roster only.
location.title: Location

maxEmployees.description: Roster cap per company (1-2500). Ignored when includeEmployees is false. Large companies are sampled.
maxEmployees.title: Max employees per company

maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap across company summaries, employee rows, and error rows (1-10000).
maxItemsTotal.title: Max dataset items

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional advanced override. The actor works without a proxy and chooses a working connection automatically.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

seniorityLevels.description: Roster filter: one or more LinkedIn seniority levels. Empty means all levels. Cookie roster only. Allowed values: Entry, Associate, Mid-Senior, Director, Executive.
seniorityLevels.title: Seniority levels

startPage.description: Resume the roster from this page (1-250, 10 employees per page). Use it to continue a capped run.
startPage.title: Roster start page

titleKeywords.description: Roster filter: free-text role or headline match, e.g. Software Engineer or VP Sales. Cookie roster only.
titleKeywords.title: Title / headline keywords

title: LinkedIn Company Headcount & Team Directory Scraper Input
